Through: Mr. Vikas Pahwa, Sr. Advo  Mr. Gurpreet Singh, Advoc  versus  STATE & ANR .....
 Through: Mr. Manoj Pant, APP for t  with Inspector Harpal Mad  Mr. Dinesh, Advoc  complainant/respondent no  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE SWARANA KANTA SHARMA  ORDER % 20.01.2023 CRL.M.A. 1353/2023 (granting permission for visiting abroad in terms of order dated 10.10.2019)
1.

The instant application under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed by the applicant seeking necessary orders and directions for granting permission to travel abroad from 19.01.2023 to 08.02.2023.
2.
The applicant herein is one of the accused in case FIR bearing number 75/2015, registered at Police Station Economic Offence Wing, under Sections 409/420/120B of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("IPC").
Charge sheet in the present case was filed under Sections 420/120B of IPC and applicant and his son (co-accused) were not arrested during the course of investigation.
Cognizance was taken by the learned Trial Court vide order dated 11.12.2018 and accused persons were summoned.
The applicant, thereafter, had preferred the present petition i.e. Crl.M.C. 5109/2019 for quashing of order dated 11.12.2018.

While issuing notice of this petition, this Court vide order dated 10.10.2019 granted exemption to the applicant from his personal appearance before the Trial Court, however, a condition, not to leave the country, was imposed upon him.
3. Learned senior counsel for the applicant submits that the grandson of applicant namely Mr.

Krishan Katyal, who is the son of co-accused Amit Katyal, is settled in London, United Kingdom,
and is getting married at Cebu, Philippines on 05.02.2023, and the applicant, being the grandfather,
has to attend his wedding.

It is stated that co-accused Amit Katyal, who is actually the main accused O.P. Katyal vs State & Anr on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11774291/
1 as well as director of accused companies, has already been granted permission to travel abroad to attend the wedding of his son by the learned Trial Court.

It is submitted by learned senior counsel for applicant that applicant has co-operated in the investigation and has never breached or flouted any of the conditions imposed by the Courts and has always obeyed the same in proper and legal manner.
It is further submitted that applicant, who is currently 80 years old, was charge-sheeted without arrest which also shows that he is a law-abiding citizen.
4. Per contra, learned APP for the State, submits that the allegations against the applicant are serious in nature.

It is stated that though the details of the marriage of applicant's grandson have been verified from the mother of applicant's grandson, the applicant has not annexed the air tickets or copy of visa with the present application.

5. Learned counsel for respondent no. 2, duly assisting learned APP for State, argues that the applicant is accused of committing fraud to the tune of Rs. 6.28 crores, and has several other cases pending against him.

It is further stated that if such permission as prayed is granted to the applicant, he shall never return back and this intention of applicant is clear from the fact that he has been making efforts to wind up his businesses in India for some time.

6. Heard the rival submissions of the parties and perusal the material placed on record.
7.
The applicant herein seeks permission to travel abroad with his family from 19.01.2023 to 08.02.2023 to attend the marriage of his grandson, who resides in London, United Kingdom.
A copy of the wedding card has been annexed with the instant application, as per which the marriage is scheduled to take place on 05.02.2023 in Cebu, Philippines.

The applicant has also annexed the itinerary of his travel, as per which he intends to visit London on 19.01.2023 for being with his grandson and to look after the preparation for wedding, and then to leave from London on 02.02.2023 for Cebu, Philippines by taking a connecting flight through Dubai, and reach Cebu,
Philippines on 03.02.2023.

Thereafter, as per the itinerary, the applicant would attend the wedding on 05.02.2023 at Cebu and leave for Delhi on 07.02.2023 and would reach Delhi on 08.02.2023 through a connecting flight from Dubai.
The Investigating Officer has verified the details qua the marriage of the grandson of applicant.
8. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, the applicant is allowed to travel abroad, from 20.01.2023 to 08.02.2023.

It is also clarified that applicant shall not be entitled to any further extension of the aforesaid duration for which he has been permitted to travel abroad i.e. 20.01.2023 to 08.02.2023.
10.
The application is disposed of in above terms.
11. Order be given Dasti under signatures of Court Master.
12. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J JANUARY 20, 2023/
